In detail

The lower town: Ban Jelačić square, Tkalčićeva, the Green Horseshoe of parks and museums, and where visitors stay. 889 recorded offences in 2025, fourth highest of the districts — a number to read alongside the fact that this is where almost all of the city's footfall, nightlife and tourism sit. Zagreb recorded 11,890 criminal offences citywide in 2025, down 2.1%, with all twelve homicides solved; the categories that rose were drug offences, break-ins and car theft. Pickpocketing in the crowded streets and ordinary care after closing time is the sum of it.

This specific area was reviewed against credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — and the signals were consolidated across sources rather than taken from any single report, with the reasoning and the sources shown above. Zagreb publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is Donji grad safe?

Wandroz currently rates Donji grad in Zagreb as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zagreb during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Zagreb at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Is Donji grad safe at night?

At night, Donji grad is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Zagreb. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Donji grad's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zagreb) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
